rationale: p99 of per-instance CPU usage rates over the cell — claim #1 (quantile accuracy). Natural for the Google trace because instance_usage is sampled at 5-min intervals across all instances in a cell.
p50 of per-instance CPU usage rates — paired with p99 for the quantile accuracy claim.
Per-zone p99 memory usage — exercises group-by + quantile (claim #2 cross-key roll-up accuracy).
Top-10 busiest hosts by CPU — claim #3 (heavy-hitter accuracy with CountSketch). Natural Google-trace question: 'which machines are most loaded?'
Top-10 services by sample count — heavy-hitter on identity, complements the CPU-load topk.
Cluster-wide CPU rate — claim #4 (counter exactness; Sum aggregation should be lossless).
Per-zone memory total — exercises sum + group-by, the simplest cross-key roll-up (claim #2).
Distinct-service cardinality — claim #5 (HLL accuracy). Natural Google-trace question: 'how many unique services are running in this cell?'
Distinct-host cardinality — exercises HLL on a different attribute and confirms cross-attribute consistency.
Distinct-instance cardinality — saturates at --cardinality-cap when the cap is engaged; the harness scales by U/N to recover the true count (see otlp_mapper.py docstring 'Cardinality cap').
